(!nodes[fromName] || !nodes[toName]) return null;\n286:         if (fromName === toName) return [nodes[toName].pos.clone()];\n287:         const prev = {}; prev[fromName] = fromName;\n288:         const queue = [fromName];\n289:         while (queue.length) {\n290:             const cur = queue.shift();\n291:             if (cur === toName) break;\n292:             const ls = nodes[cur].links;\n293:             for (let i = 0; i < ls.length; i++) {\n294:                 const nb = ls[i];\n295:                 if (!(nb in prev)) { prev[nb] = cur; queue.push(nb); }\n296:             }\n297:         }\n298:         if (!(toName in prev)) return null;\n299:         const names = [];\n300:         let cur = toName;\n301:         while (cur !== fromName) { names.push(cur); cur = prev[cur]; }\n302:         names.push(fromName);\n303:         names.reverse();\n304:         return names.map(function (n) { return nodes[n].pos.clone(); });\n305:     }\n306: \n307: s.lineTo(0.13, -0.1); s.lineTo(0, 0.13);\n        } else {\n            s.moveTo(-0.13, 0.1); s.lineTo(0.13, 0.1); s.lineTo(0, -0.13);\n        }\n        return new THREE.ShapeGeometry(s);\n    }\n\n    const ARROW_OFF_MAT = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x2a2f2a });\n    const ARROW_ON_MAT = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x39ff5e });\n\n    function makeCallPanel() {\n        const g = new THREE.Group();\n        const plate = box(0.55, 1.4, 0.05, solidMat(0x33363f));\n        plate.position.y = 0;\n        g.add(plate);\n\n        const upArrow = new THREE.Mesh(makeArrowGeometry(true), ARROW_OFF_MAT);\n        upArrow.position.set(0, 0.42, 0.032);\n        g.add(upArrow);\n\n        const downArrow = new THREE.Mesh(makeArrowGeometry(false), ARROW_OFF_MAT);\n        downArrow.position.set(0, 0.12, 0.032);\n        g.add(downArrow);\n\n        const tex = makeTextTexture(\"0\");\n        const disp = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.45, 0.45),\n            new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex }));\n        disp.position.set(0, -0.38, 0.032);\n        g.add(disp);\n\n        g.userData.setUp = function (on) { upArrow.material = on ? = { pos: new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z), links: [] };\n    }\n\n    function link(nodes, a, b) {\n        if (!nodes[a] || !nodes[b]) {\n            console.warn(\"link: missing node\", a, b);\n            return;\n        }\n        if (nodes[a].links.indexOf(b) === -1) nodes[a].links.push(b);\n        if (nodes[b].links.indexOf(a) === -1) nodes[b].links.push(a);\n    }\n\n    function bfsPath(nodes, fromName, toName) {\n        if (!nodes[fromName] || !nodes[toName]) return null;\n        if (fromName === toName) return [nodes[toName].pos.clone()];\n        const prev = {}; prev[fromName] = fromName;\n        const queue = [fromName];\n        while (queue.length) {\n            const cur = queue.shift();\n            if (cur === toName) break;\n            const ls = nodes[cur].links;\n            for (let i = 0; i < ls.length; i++) {\n                const nb = ls[i];\n                if (!(nb in prev)) { prev[nb] = cur; queue.push(nb); }\n            }\n        }\n        if (!(toName in prev)) return null;\n        const names = [];\n        let cur = toName;\n        while (cur !== fromName) { names.push(cur); cur = prev[cur]; }\n        names.push(fromName);\n        names.reverse();\n        return names.map(function (n) { return nodes[n].pos.clone(); });\n    }\n\n    function nearestNodeName(nodes, pos) {\n        let best = null, bestD = Infinity;\n        for (const name in nodes) {\n            const d = nodes[name].pos.distanceToSquared(pos);\n            if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = name; }\n        }\n        return best;\n    }\n\n    // ---------------- wall building helpers ----------------\n\n    function wallX(group, x, z0, z1, y0, y1, mat) {\n        // wall in a constant-x plane\n        const h = y1 - y0, d = Math.abs(z1 - z0);\n        const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(d, h), mat);\n        m.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;\n        m.position.set(x, y0 + h / 2, (z0 + z1) / 2);\n        group.add(m);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    function wallZ(group, z, x0, x1, y0, y1, mat) {\n        // wall in a constant-z plane\n        const h = y1 - y0, w = Math.abs(x1 - x0);\n        const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, h), mat);\n        m.position.set((x0 + x1) / 2, y0 + h / 2, z);\n        group.add(m);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    // ---------------- per-floor construction   }\n}\n\n// --- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfunction tickUntil(ev, pred, maxTicks, label) {\n    maxTicks = maxTicks || 5000;\n    for (let i = 0; i < maxTicks; i++) {\n        if (pred(ev)) return i;\n        ev.tick(DT);\n    }\n    throw new Error(`tickUntil(${label || \"predicate\"}) exceeded ${maxTicks} ticks ` +\n        `(state=${ev.state} floor=${ev.currentFloor} target=${ev.targetFloor})`);\n}\n\nfunction runUntilDoorOpenAt(ev, floor, maxTicks) {\n    return tickUntil(ev,\n        (e) => e.state === \"DOOR_OPEN\" && e.currentFloor === floor,\n        maxTicks, `DOOR_OPEN@${floor}`);\n}\n\nfunction runUntilDoorClosed(ev, maxTicks) {\n    // run until doors finish closing (state leaves DOOR_OPEN/DOOR_CLOSING)\n    tickUntil(ev, (e) => e.state === \"DOOR_OPEN\", maxTicks, \"reach DOOR_OPEN\");\n    return tickUntil(ev,\n        (e) => e.state === \"IDLE\" || e.state === \"MOVING\",\n        maxTicks, \"doors Repeated hall-call pressing cannot starve riders ---------------------\n\ntest(\"repeated callUp(0) cannot starve riders' destinations\", () => {\n    const ev = new ElevatorLogic({ floorCount: 6, maxCapacity: 4 });\n    ev.callUp(0);\n    runUntilDoorOpenAt(ev, 0);\n    boardRider(ev, \"a\", 3);\n    boardRider(ev, \"b\", 5);\n\n    let reachedDest = false;\n    for (let i = 0; i < 3000; i++) {\n        ev.callUp(0); // hammer the lobby button every tick\n        ev.tick(DT);\n        if (ev.state === \"DOOR_OPEN\" && (ev.currentFloor === 3 || ev.currentFloor === 5)) {\n            reachedDest = true;\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    assert.ok(reachedDest, \"car must still reach a passenger destination\");\n});\n\n// --- 4. Opposite-direction calls wait their turn -----------------------------\n\ntest(\"down call below does not reverse an upward car with work above\", () => {\n    const ev = new ElevatorLogic({ floorCount: 6, maxCapacity: 4 });\n    ev.callUp(0);\n    runUntilDoorOpenAt(ev, 0);\n    boardRider(ev, \"up1\", 4);\n    boardRider(ev, \"up2\", 5);\n\n    runUntilDoorClosed(ev);\n    assert.strictEqual(ev.direction, 1, \"car should be heading up\");\n\n    // While moving up, a DOWN call arrives at floor 1 (below / behind)\n    ev.callDown(1);\n    ev.callDown(2);\n\n    // Car must serve 4 then 5 before turning around for the down calls.\n    runUntilDoorOpenAt(ev, 4);\n    assert.ok(ev.downCalls.has(1) && ev.downCalls.has(2), \"down calls still queued at floor 4\");\n    runUntilDoorOpenAt(ev, 5);\n    // after the top, it may reverse and serve the down calls\n    tickUntil(ev, (e) => e.state === \"DOOR_OPEN\" && (e.currentFloor === 2 || e.currentFloor === 1),\n        8000, \"serve down calls after reversing\");\n    assert.ok(true);\n});\n\n// --- 5. Door hold and safety cap ---------------------------------------------\n\ntest(\"doors hold for pending boarders, then MAX_DOOR_OPEN_S cap closes them\", () => {\n    const ev = new ElevatorLogic({ floorCount: 6, maxCapacity: 4 });\n    ev.callUp(0);\n    runUntilDoorOpenAt(ev, 0);\n\n    const spot = ev.reserveBoardingSpot(\"slowpoke\");\n    assert.ok(spot, \"slowpoke gets a spot\");\n    // never completes boarding…\n\n    // after MIN_DOOR_OPEN_S the doors must STILL be open (held by pendingBoarders)\n    const minTicks = Math.ceil((ev.MIN_DOOR_OPEN_S + 0.5) / DT);\n    for (let i = 0; i < minTicks; i++) ev.tick(DT);\n    assert.strictEqual(ev.state, \"DOOR_OPEN\", \"doors held open past min time by pending boarder\");\n\n    // …but MAX_DOOR_OPEN_S eventually force-closes\n    const capTicks = Math.ceil((ev.MAX_DOOR_OPEN_S + 1.0) / DT);\n    for (let i = 0; i < capTicks; i++) ev.tick(DT);\n    assert.notStrictEqual(ev.state, \"DOOR_OPEN\", \"safety cap must close the doors\");\n    assert.strictEqual(ev.pendingBoarders.size, 0, \"stuck boarder abandoned\");\n    assert.strictEqual(ev.spotOccupancy.filter(Boolean).length, 0, \"spot released\");\n\n    // also verify a disembarker holds the doors\n    const ev2 = new ElevatorLogic({ floorCount: 6, maxCapacity: 4 });\n    ev2.callUp(0);\n    runUntilDoorOpenAt(ev2, 0);\n    boardRider(ev2, \"r\", 3);\n    runUntilDoorOpenAt(ev2, 3);\n    ev2.registerDisembark(\"r\");\n    const holdTicks = Math.ceil((ev2.MIN_DOOR_OPEN_S + 1.0) / DT);\n    for (let i = 0; i < holdTicks; i++) ev2.tick(DT);\n    assert.strictEqual(ev2.state, \"DOOR_OPEN\", \"doors held for pending disembark\");\n    ev2.completeDisembark(\"r\");\n    tickUntil(ev2, (e) => e.state !== \"DOOR_OPEN\", 1000, \"close after disembark completes\");\n});\n\n// --- 6. const d = allDesks[id];\n                a.homeFloor = d.floor;\n                a.deskId = d.id;\n                a.deskWp = d.deskWp;\n                a.doorWp = d.doorWp;\n                sampleWorkerSchedule(a);\n            } else {\n                sampleVisitorSchedule(a);\n            }\n            agents.push(a);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function countPresent() {\n        let n = 0;\n        for (let i = 0; i < agents.length; i++) {\n            const s = agents[i].state;\n            if (s !== \"AWAY\" && s !== \"GONE\" && s !== \"DISABLED\") n++;\n        }\n        return n;\n    }\n\n    function resetDay() {\n        agents.forEach(function (a) {\n            if (a.group.parent) a.group.parent.remove(a.group);\n            releaseSeat(a);\n            a.plan = [];\n            a.currentAction = null;\n            a.throughDoor = false;\n            a.group.userData.isSitting = false;\n            a.group.userData.isWalking = false;\n            a.floorIdx = 0;\n            a.state = a.id < targetOccupancy ? \"AWAY\" : \"DISABLED\";\n            if (a.role === \"WORKER\") sampleWorkerSchedule(a);\n            else sampleVisitorSchedule(a);\n        });\n        seatReservations.clear();\n        elevator.reset();   // phantom passengers would jam the next day\n    }\n\n    function applyOccupancy() {\n        agents.forEach(function (a) {\n            if (a.id < targetOccupancy) {\n                if (a.state === \"DISABLED\") {\n                    a.state = \"AWAY\";\n                    if (Clock.simMinute > a.arrivalTime && Clock.simMinute < 960) {\n                        a.arrivalTime = Clock.simMinute + rand(1, 15);\n                    }\n                }\n            } else if (a.state === \"AWAY\") {\n                a.state = \"DISABLED\";\n                // mid-day agents finish naturally; parked on day-wrap\n            }\n        });\n    }\n\n    // The dynamic top-up: visitors cycle arrive -> visit -> leave -> gap ->\n    // arrive again, so the concurrent population tracks the slider.\n    function topUpVisitors() {\n        const m = Clock.simMinute;\n        if (m < 480 || m > 1050) return;   // business hours only\n        let incoming = 0;\n        agents.forEach(function (a) {\n            if (a.state === \"AWAY\" && a.arrivalTime <= m + 6) incoming++;\n        });\n        let deficit = targetOccupancy - countPresent() - incoming;\n        if (deficit <= 0) return;\n        for (let i = 0; i < agents.length && deficit > 0; i++) {\n            const a = agents[i];\n            if (a.role !== \"VISITOR\" || a.id >= targetOccupancy) continue;\n            if (a.state === \"GONE\" || (a.state === \"AWAY\" && a.arrivalTime > m + 6)) {\n                a.arrivalTime = m + randInt(0, 6);   // re-roll arrival\n                sampleVisitorSchedule(a);            // re-roll the visit\n                a.arrivalTime = m + randInt(0, 6);\n                a.state = \"AWAY\";\n                deficit--;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------------- primitive actions ----------------\n\n    function A(type, props) {\n        const a = { type: type };\n        if (props) for (const k in props) a[k] = props[k];\n        return a;\n    }\n\n    function dirOf(from, to) { return to > from ? 1 : -1; }\n\n    // personal waiting spot in front of the elevator: spread agents out\n    function panelWaitSpot(agent, floor) {\n        const ang = agent.id * 2.39996;\n        const r = 0.55 + (agent.id % 4) * 0.3;\n        let x = Math.cos(ang) * r * 1.7;\n        let z = 2.45 + Math.abs(Math.sin(ang)) * r * 0.9 + 0.15;\n        x = Math.max(-2.3, Math.min(2.3, x));\n        z = Math.max(1.95, Math.min(4.4, z));\n        return new THREE.Vector3(x, floor * FH, z);\n    }\n\n    function moveToward(agent, target, dt, speed) {\n        // returns remaining distance after the move; rotates to face motion\n        const g = agent.group;\n        const dx = target.x - g.position.x;\n        const dz = target.z - g.position.z;\n        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);\n        if (dist < 1e-6) return 0;\n        const step = Math.min(dist, (speed || WALK_SPEED) * dt);\n        g.position.x += dx / dist * step;\n        g.position.z += dz / dist * step;\n        g.rotation.y = Math.atan2(dx, dz);\n        return dist - step;\n    }\n\n    function startAction(agent, act) {\n        const g = agent.group;\n        // entrance-chain collision exemption (front door can never be dammed)\n        agent.throughDoor = (act.type === \"WALK_TO_WP\" && ENTRANCE_WPS[act.wp]) ? true : false;\n        switch (act.type) {\n            case \"WALK_TO_WP\": {\n                const nodes = world.floors[act.floor].nodes;\n                const fromName = world.nearestNodeName(nodes, g.position);\n                const path = bfsPath(nodes, fromName, act.wp) || [nodes[act.wp].pos.clone()];\n                act._path = path;\n                act._i = 0;\n                act._stallT = 0;\n                act._prev = g.position.clone();\n                g.userData.isWalking = true;\n                g.userData.isSitting = false;\n                break;\n            }\n            case \"WAIT_AT_PANEL\":\n                act._spot = panelWaitSpot(agent, act.floor);\n                g.userData.isWalking = false;\n                break;\n            case \"ENTER_ELEVATOR\":\n                act._phase = 0;\n                act._stallT = 0;\n                g.userData.isWalking = true;\n                break;\n            case \"EXIT_ELEVATOR\": {\n                elevator.registerDisembark(agent);\n                // reparent car -> scene, preserving world position\n                const wp = new THREE.Vector3();\n                g.getWorldPosition(wp);\n                scene.add(g);\n                g.position.set(wp.x, act.floor * FH, wp.z);\n                agent.floorIdx = act.floor;\n                act._target = panelWaitSpot(agent, act.floor);\n                act._stallT = 0;\n                g.userData.isWalking = true;\n                break;\n            }\n            case \"WAIT_SIM\":\n                act._untilMin = Clock.simMinute + act.minutes;  // resolved HERE, not at compile\n                g.userData.isWalking = false;\n                break;\n            default:\n                break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // returns true when the action is complete\n    function updateAction(agent, act, dt) {\n        const g = agent.group;\n        switch (act.type) {\n\n            case \"WALK_TO_WP\": {\n                const path = act._path;\n                if (act._i >= path.length) {\n                    g.userData.isWalking = false;\n                    return true;\n                }\n                const target = path[act._i];\n                const before = g.position.distanceTo(target);\n                moveToward(agent, target, dt);\n                const moved = g.position.distanceTo(act._prev);\n                act._prev.copy(g.position);\n                if (moved < 0.005) {\n                    // blocked: skip the waypoint after ~1.2 motion-seconds of\n                    // no progress (front-door stall recovery included)\n                    act._stallT += dt;\n                    if (act._stallT > 1.2) {\n                        act._i++;\n                        act._stallT = 0;\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    act._stallT = 0;\n                }\n                if (before < 0.1 || g.position.distanceTo(target) < 0.1) act._i++;\n                if (act._i >= path.length) {\n                    g.userData.isWalking = false;\n                    return true;\n                }\n                return false;\n            }\n\n            case \"WAIT_AT_PANEL\": {\n                // re-press the call every frame in case a cycle cleared it\n                if (act.dir > 0) elevator.callUp(act.floor);\n                else elevator.callDown(act.floor);\n                // drift to a personal waiting spot so waiters don't stack\n                const d = g.position.distanceTo(act._spot);\n                if (d > 0.12) {\n                    g.userData.isWalking = true;\n                    moveToward(agent, act._spot, dt, WALK_SPEED * 0.7);\n                } else {\n                    g.userData.isWalking = false;\n                    g.rotation.y = Math.PI;   // face the elevator doors\n                }\n                return elevator.isAcceptingAt(act.floor, act.dir) &&\n                    elevator.currentCapacityFree() > 0;\n            }\n\n            case \"ENTER_ELEVATOR\": {\n                // Phases fall through within one call: at high time scales a\n                // single frame must be able to cover reserve -> walk ->\n                // reparent -> walk-in -> completeBoard, or the door timer\n                // (which also runs frames) abandons the boarder mid-walk.\n                const floor = agent.floorIdx;\n\n                if (act._phase === 0) {            // reserve a spot\n                    if (!(elevator.state === \"DOOR_OPEN\" && elevator.currentFloor === floor)) {\n                        requeueBoard(agent, act);\n                        return true;\n                    }\n                    const spot = elevator.reserveBoardingSpot(agent);\n                    if (!spot) {\n                        requeueBoard(agent, act);\n                        return true;\n                    }\n                    act._spot = spot;\n                    // aim the walk-to-door at the reserved spot's X lane, so\n                    // the four boarders enter on separate lanes\n                    const laneX = Math.max(-0.75, Math.min(0.75, spot.local.x));\n                    act._threshold = new THREE.Vector3(laneX, floor * FH, 1.45);\n                    act._phase = 1;\n                    act._prev = g.position.clone();\n                    g.userData.isWalking = true;\n                }\n\n                if (act._phase === 1) {            // walk to the door threshold (world)\n                    if (!(elevator.state === \"DOOR_OPEN\" && elevator.currentFloor === floor)) {\n                        elevator.cancelBoard(agent);   // car slipped away — start over\n                        requeueBoard(agent, act);\n                        return true;\n                    }\n                    moveToward(agent, act._threshold, dt);\n                    const moved = g.position.distanceTo(act._prev);\n                    act._prev.copy(g.position);\n                    if (moved < 0.005) {\n                        act._stallT += dt;\n                        if (act._stallT > 1.5) {   // crowd-block recovery: force through\n                            g.position.copy(act._threshold);\n                            act._stallT = 0;\n                        }\n                    } else {\n                        act._stallT = 0;\n                    }\n                    if (g.position.distanceTo(act._threshold) < 0.1) {\n                        // reparent scene -> car\n                        const car = elevator.car;\n                        g.position.set(g.position.x - car.position.x, 0, g.position.z - car.position.z);\n                        car.add(g);\n                        act._phase = 2;            // fall through this frame\n                    } else {\n                        return false;\n                    }\n                }\n\n                // phase 2: walk to the reserved interior spot (car-local)\n                if (!elevator.pendingBoarders.has(agent) && !elevator.passengers.has(agent)) {\n                    // force-abandoned by the door safety cap — step back out\n                    const wp = new THREE.Vector3();\n                    g.getWorldPosition(wp);\n                    scene.add(g);\n                    g.position.set(wp.x, agent.floorIdx * FH, Math.max(wp.z, 2.0));\n                    requeueBoard(agent, act);\n                    return true;\n                }\n                moveToward(agent, act._spot.local, dt);\n                act._stallT += dt;\n                if (g.position.distanceTo(act._spot.local) < 0.08 || act._stallT > 2.5) {\n                    g.position.set(act._spot.local.x, 0, act._spot.local.z);\n                    elevator.completeBoard(agent);\n                    g.rotation.y = 0;          // face the doors\n                    g.userData.isWalking = false;\n                    return true;\n                }\n                return false;\n            }\n\n            case \"PRESS_FLOOR\":\n                // exact destination from the plan compiler — never floor+dir\n                elevator.pressDestination(act.floor);\n                return true;\n\n            case \"WAIT_FOR_FLOOR\":\n                if (elevator.state === \"DOOR_OPEN\" && elevator.currentFloor === act.floor) return true;\n                // safety: re-press if our destination got cleared somehow\n                if (!elevator.destinations.has(act.floor) && elevator.currentFloor !== act.floor) {\n                    elevator.pressDestination(act.floor);\n                }\n                return false;\n\n            case \"EXIT_ELEVATOR\": {\n                const left = moveToward(agent, act._target, dt);\n                act._stallT += dt;\n                if (left < 0.12 || act._stallT > 2.5) {\n                    elevator.completeDisembark(agent);\n                    g.userData.isWalking = false;\n                    return true;\n                }\n                return false;\n            }\n\n            case \"SIT\": {\n                const fl = world.floors[act.floor];\n                const t = fl.sitTargets[act.wp];\n                const pos = fl.nodes[act.wp].pos;\n                if (t && t.sit) {\n                    // snap to the seat, drop the body so hips meet the chair,\n                    // and face the published direction (legs toward the desk\n                    // or table, away from the backrest)\n                    g.position.set(pos.x, act.floor * FH - SIT_DROP, pos.z);\n                    g.rotation.y = t.facing;\n                    g.userData.isSitting = true;\n                } else {\n                    // standing waypoint: jitter a small ring so two agents\n                    // assigned the same spot don't overlap exactly\n                    const ang = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);\n                    const r = rand(0.35, 0.75);\n                    g.position.set(pos.x + Math.cos(ang) * r, act.floor * FH, pos.z + Math.sin(ang) * r);\n                    g.rotation.y = t ? t.facing : rand(0, Math.PI * 2);\n                    g.userData.isSitting = false;\n                }\n                g.userData.isWalking = false;\n                return true;\n            }\n\n            case \"STAND\":\n                g.userData.isSitting = false;\n                g.position.y = (g.parent === elevator.car) ? 0 : agent.floorIdx * FH;\n                // NOTE: seat reservation is NOT released here — STAND also\n                // opens a plan (rising from a desk) long before the agent\n                // reaches the reserved seat. Release goes in RELEASE_SEAT.\n                return true;\n\n            case \"RELEASE_SEAT\":\n                releaseSeat(agent);\n                return true;\n\n            case \"WAIT_SIM\":\n                return Clock.simMinute >= act._untilMin;\n\n            case \"EXIT_BUILDING\":\n                if (g.parent) g.parent.remove(g);\n                agent.state = \"GONE\";\n                g.userData.isWalking = false;\n                return true;\n\n            case \"ENTER_STATE\":\n                agent.state = act.state;\n                return true;\n\n            case \"MARK_LUNCHED\":\n                agent.hasLunched = true;\n                return true;\n\n            case \"PICK_NEXT_ACTIVITY\":\n                chooseNextActivity(agent);\n                return true;\n\n            default:\n                return true;\n        }\n    }\n\n    function requeueBoard(agent, act) {\n        // car left or filled before we could board: wait + try again\n        const floor = agent.floorIdx;\n        if (act.dir > 0) elevator.callUp(floor);\n        else elevator.callDown(floor);\n        agent.plan.unshift(\n            A(\"WAIT_AT_PANEL\", { floor: floor, dir: act.dir, toFloor: act.toFloor }),\n            A(\"ENTER_ELEVATOR\", { toFloor: act.toFloor, dir: act.dir })\n        );\n    }\n\n    // ---------------- plan compilers ----------------\n\n    function ride(from, to) {\n        if (from === to) return [];\n        const dir = dirOf(from, to);\n        return [\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: from, wp: \"elevWait\" }),\n            A(\"ENTER_STATE\", { state: \"WAITING_ELEVATOR\" }),\n            A(\"WAIT_AT_PANEL\", { floor: from, dir: dir, toFloor: to }),\n            A(\"ENTER_ELEVATOR\", { toFloor: to, dir: dir }),\n            A(\"ENTER_STATE\", { state: \"IN_CAR\" }),\n            A(\"PRESS_FLOOR\", { floor: to }),       // explicit toFloor, not floor+dir\n            A(\"WAIT_FOR_FLOOR\", { floor: to }),\n            A(\"EXIT_ELEVATOR\", { floor: to }),\n            A(\"ENTER_STATE\", { state: \"ON_FLOOR\" })\n        ];\n    }\n\n    // everyone leaves the building through the real doorway, across the\n    // threshold, out onto the sidewalk — never vanishing inside the lobby\n    function walkOutChain() {\n        return [\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: 0, wp: \"lobby_center\" }),\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: 0, wp: \"entrance\" }),\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: 0, wp: \"front_door_threshold\" }),\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: 0, wp: \"outside\" }),\n            A(\"EXIT_BUILDING\")\n        ];\n    }\n\n    function backToDesk(a) {\n        return [\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: a.homeFloor, wp: a.doorWp }),\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: a.homeFloor, wp: a.deskWp }),\n            A(\"SIT\", { floor: a.homeFloor, wp: a.deskWp }),\n            A(\"ENTER_STATE\", { state: \"AT_DESK\" }),\n            A(\"WAIT_SIM\", { minutes: rand(18, 65) }),\n            A(\"PICK_NEXT_ACTIVITY\")\n        ];\n    }\n\n    function planArriveToDesk(a) {\n        return [\n            A(\"ENTER_STATE\", { state: \"ARRIVING\" }),\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: 0, wp: \"front_door_threshold\" }),\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: 0, wp: \"entrance\" }),\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: 0, wp: \"lobby_center\" })\n        ].concat(ride(0, a.homeFloor)).concat(backToDesk(a));\n    }\n\n    function planGoToLunch(a) {\n        const lobby = world.floors[0];\n        let seat = reserveFrom(a, 0, lobby.bistroChairs);\n        if (!seat) seat = reserveFrom(a, 0, lobby.frontLoungeSeats.concat(lobby.backLoungeSeats));\n        const lunchWp = seat || pick(lobby.standSpots);\n        const seatActs = [\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: 0, wp: lunchWp }),\n            A(\"SIT\", { floor: 0, wp: lunchWp })\n        ];\n        return [\n            A(\"STAND\"), A(\"ENTER_STATE\", { state: \"ON_FLOOR\" }),\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: a.homeFloor, wp: a.doorWp })\n        ].concat(ride(a.homeFloor, 0))\n            .concat(seatActs)\n            .concat([\n                A(\"ENTER_STATE\", { state: \"AT_LUNCH\" }),\n                A(\"WAIT_SIM\", { minutes: a.lunchDuration }),\n                A(\"MARK_LUNCHED\"),\n                A(\"STAND\"), A(\"RELEASE_SEAT\")\n            ])\n            .concat(ride(0, a.homeFloor))\n            .concat(backToDesk(a));\n    }\n\n    function planVisitLounge(a) {\n        const fl = world.floors[a.homeFloor];\n        let seat = reserveFrom(a, a.homeFloor, fl.loungeSpots);\n        if (!seat) seat = pick(fl.standSpots);   // stand at the cooler instead\n        return [\n            A(\"STAND\"), A(\"ENTER_STATE\", { state: \"ON_FLOOR\" }),\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: a.homeFloor, wp: a.doorWp }),\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: a.homeFloor, wp: seat }),\n            A(\"SIT\", { floor: a.homeFloor, wp: seat }),\n            A(\"ENTER_STATE\", { state: \"AT_BREAK\" }),\n            A(\"WAIT_SIM\", { minutes: rand(5, 12) }),\n            A(\"STAND\"), A(\"RELEASE_SEAT\")\n        ].concat(backToDesk(a));\n    }\n\n    function planAttendMeeting(a) {\n        const mf = Math.random() < 0.65 ? a.homeFloor : randInt(1, WORLD.FLOOR_COUNT - 1);\n        const seat = reserveConfSeat(a, mf);\n        if (!seat) return planVisitLounge(a);    // all four seats taken\n        return [\n            A(\"STAND\"), A(\"ENTER_STATE\", { state: \"ON_FLOOR\" }),\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: a.homeFloor, wp: a.doorWp })\n        ].concat(ride(a.homeFloor, mf))\n            .concat([\n                A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: mf, wp: seat }),\n                A(\"SIT\", { floor: mf, wp: seat }),\n                A(\"ENTER_STATE\", { state: \"IN_MEETING\" }),\n                A(\"WAIT_SIM\", { minutes: rand(22, 45) }),\n                A(\"STAND\"), A(\"RELEASE_SEAT\")\n            ])\n            .concat(ride(mf, a.homeFloor))\n            .concat(backToDesk(a));\n    }\n\n    function planVisitCoworker(a) {\n        const candidates = agents.filter(function (o) {\n            return o !== a && o.role === \"WORKER\" && o.state === \"AT_DESK\";\n        });\n        if (!candidates.length) {\n            return [A(\"WAIT_SIM\", { minutes: rand(10, 25) }), A(\"PICK_NEXT_ACTIVITY\")];\n        }\n        const c = pick(candidates);\n        return [\n            A(\"STAND\"), A(\"ENTER_STATE\", { state: \"ON_FLOOR\" }),\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: a.homeFloor, wp: a.doorWp })\n        ].concat(ride(a.homeFloor, c.homeFloor))\n            .concat([\n                A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: c.homeFloor, wp: c.doorWp }),\n                A(\"ENTER_STATE\", { state: \"VISITING\" }),\n                A(\"WAIT_SIM\", { minutes: rand(6, 18) })\n            ])\n            .concat(ride(c.homeFloor, a.homeFloor))\n            .concat(backToDesk(a));\n    }\n\n    function planLeaveBuilding(a) {\n        return [\n            A(\"STAND\"), A(\"RELEASE_SEAT\"),\n            A(\"ENTER_STATE\", { state: \"LEAVING\" })\n        ].concat(ride(a.floorIdx, 0)).concat(walkOutChain());\n    }\n\n    function planVisitorVisit(a) {\n        const lobby = world.floors[0];\n        const r = Math.random();\n        let acts = [];\n\n        function sitFor(floor, wp, lo, hi, state) {\n            return [\n                A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: floor, wp: wp }),\n                A(\"SIT\", { floor: floor, wp: wp }),\n                A(\"ENTER_STATE\", { state: state || \"VISITING\" }),\n                A(\"WAIT_SIM\", { minutes: rand(lo, hi) }),\n                A(\"STAND\"), A(\"RELEASE_SEAT\")\n            ];\n        }\n        function loiter() {\n            return sitFor(0, pick(lobby.standSpots), 4, 15);\n        }\n\n        if (r < 0.10) {                                   // bistro table\n            const s = reserveFrom(a, 0, lobby.bistroChairs);\n            acts = s ? sitFor(0, s, 8, 25) : loiter();\n        } else if (r < 0.16) {                            // cafe counter\n            acts = sitFor(0, lobby.cafeOrder, 2, 6);\n        } else if (r < 0.30) {                            // front lounge\n            const s = reserveFrom(a, 0, lobby.frontLoungeSeats);\n            acts = s ? sitFor(0, s, 6, 20) : loiter();\n        } else if (r < 0.42) {                            // back lounge / pit\n            const s = reserveFrom(a, 0, lobby.backLoungeSeats.concat(lobby.pitSeats));\n            acts = s ? sitFor(0, s, 6, 20) : loiter();\n        } else if (r < 0.52) {                            // reception / kiosk / cooler\n            acts = sitFor(0, pick(lobby.quickStops), 2, 6);\n        } else if (r < 0.62) {                            // lobby loiter\n            acts = loiter();\n        } else if (r < 0.77) {                            // office-floor lounge\n            const f = randInt(1, WORLD.FLOOR_COUNT - 1);\n            const fl = world.floors[f];\n            let s = reserveFrom(a, f, fl.loungeSpots);\n            if (!s) s = pick(fl.standSpots);\n            acts = ride(0, f).concat(sitFor(f, s, 6, 18)).concat(ride(f, 0));\n        } else {                                          // sit in on a meeting\n            const f = randInt(1, WORLD.FLOOR_COUNT - 1);\n            const s = reserveConfSeat(a, f);\n            if (s) {\n                acts = ride(0, f)\n                    .concat(sitFor(f, s, 22, 45, \"IN_MEETING\"))\n                    .concat(ride(f, 0));\n            } else {\n                acts = loiter();                          // all four seats taken\n            }\n        }\n\n        return [\n            A(\"ENTER_STATE\", { state: \"ARRIVING\" }),\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: 0, wp: \"front_door_threshold\" }),\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: 0, wp: \"entrance\" }),\n            A(\"WALK_TO_WP\", { floor: 0, wp: \"lobby_center\" })\n        ].concat(acts).concat(walkOutChain());\n    }\n\n    // ---------------- decision rules ----------------\n\n    function chooseNextActivity(a) {\n        if (a.role !== \"WORKER\") {\n            a.plan = [];\n            return;\n        }\n        const m = Clock.simMinute;\n\n        if (m >= a.departureTime) {                       // 1. go home\n            a.plan = planLeaveBuilding(a);\n            return;\n        }\n        for (let i = 0; i < a.plannedMeetingTimes.length; i++) {\n            if (m >= a.plannedMeetingTimes[i]) {          // 2. scheduled meeting\n                a.plannedMeetingTimes.splice(i, 1);\n                a.plan = planAttendMeeting(a);\n                return;\n            }\n        }\n        if (m >= a.lunchTime && !a.hasLunched) {          // 3. lunch\n            a.plan = planGoToLunch(a);\n            return;\n        }\n        const r = Math.random();                          // 4. weighted roll\n        if (r < MEETING_PROB * 0.4) {                     // ~14% ad-hoc meeting\n            a.plan = planAttendMeeting(a);\n        } else if (r < MEETING_PROB * 0.4 + 0.12) {       // ~12% lounge break\n
